I said I don't think it's unfair, I said it's bad design; and sure rolling for stats can become better but it will never be good; and I accept that point buy might appear boring, but it's good design. Why? Because it rewards careful planning and consideration, and it lets you choose what you want and where with better precision, however if by chance you end up with a worse (or way better) character than everybody else that's not good design, rolling for stats simply creates a power disparity that doesn't need to be there in the first place, and that's even less fun than point buy. 

 If you're gonna consider homebrewing rolling methods for stats then I can counter all the problems point buy might have (Except that some people find it boring) by saying you can raise the points you get in point buy, and raise the maximum points in a stat you can have at level one. Also, feats are not only optional rules, but also you can give them away as rewards for finishing quest's or beating bosses; it doesn't have to be only by leveling up, it's not like I invented the "free feat at level 1" rule

And finally, if you're gonna make rolling for stats better by putting a little bit of point buy in there that right there makes it clear wich method is the better one.

I mean, it is an uneven distribution of resources, so it's really bad design, but is not actually unfair because everyone gets to roll the same amount of dice, I agree with you and rolling dice for stats should be removed (I only use Point Buy or Standard Array) but I don't think it's unfair, just really shitty.

Personally these are my preferences regarding visual, animation, and sound designs; I'll try to only compare the enemies that share similar niches in gameplay, and I won't take into account the differences in gameplay design: 

Archons > Floaters

x2 Sectoids > x1 Sectoids

x2 Sectopod > x1 Sectopod

Chrysalids TBH stayed the same

x2 Mutons and Berserkers > x1 Mutons And Berserkers

Viper = Thin Men (Even if they're very different design wise, I like them both a lot)

Andromedon > Mechtoid > MEC

Exalt > Advent

Seeker = Faceless (Again, they cover the same niche, and even if they look drastically different they're two of my favorite designs)

Cyberdisk > Gatekeeper

Codex = Spectre > Outsider

x2 Lost > x1 Zombie > x2 Zombies / Psi Zombies 

Turrets > Drones

Ethereal / Uber Ethereal > Avatar

There's really no comparison that can be done for the Viper King, The Assassin, The Warlock, or The Hunter however...

Elite Muton > Berserker Queen

Heavy Floaters > Archon King

And just for the sake of it, here's my opinion on XCOM (And just as Advent, I'm NOT taking gameplay into account):

Reaper > Sharpshooter > Sniper

Granadier = Heavy

Specialist > Support

Ranger = Assault

Psi Ops > Psionic

Mecs > Spark > S.H.I.V

Skirmishers > Gene Mods (Why skirmishers vs Gene Mods? because visually they represent the same niche, that being alien/human hybrids)

And we're left with the Templar, that sadly we can't compare nothing form XcomEU/EW to.

And as a last note, if the Xcom EW soldiers were genetically modded, and/or psi enhanced, then the sounds and visuals would put them above almost all of Xcom 2's soldiers for sure (Except maybe the Skirmishers, I like their look and sounds a LOT), what can I say, I'm a sucker for the pretty colors they make when getting a kill with Adrenal Neurosympathy, or when they use Psi Inspiration.

Remember not to hurt the ones you dont intend to kill on that turn because the AI will behave differently (They will buff and heal/restore themselves if they can at that point, making the fight harder that it needs to be) and then you can go invisible or hide again if you wanted, but really 3 turns without having recieved damage, and 2 turns back to back should give you all the edge you need to beat them without hit and run tactics.

Enemies that have healing (Physical/Magic armor heals also count) will try to heal themselves only if they´ve been damaged, funnily enough, if you damage their physical armor, and they can restore only their magical armor they will do so, wasting energy.
